description: This Java class 'CollateralAssembler' provides functionality to parse JSON data and assemble a set of 'LoanCollateral' objects, either creating new ones or updating existing ones based on the JSON input. It interacts with repositories to fetch data and handles JSON parsing and data transformation.

classes.name: CollateralAssembler
classes.description: A service class responsible for creating or updating 'LoanCollateral' objects from JSON input, facilitating data parsing and repository interactions for collateral management.

methods.name: fromParsedJson
methods.description: Parses a JsonElement to extract collateral data, creating a set of LoanCollateral objects. It handles both creation of new collateral items and updating existing ones based on the JSON input.
